sources.entry: QloApps - Customizable and intuitive web-based hotel reservation system and a booking engine. (Demo, Source Code) OSL-3.0 PHP/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: QloApps is an open-source, web-based hotel reservation system and booking engine for launching a hotel booking website and managing bookings.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes QloApps as a free, open-source hotel reservation system and booking engine aimed at hotels ranging from small independent properties to large chains. It is positioned as a way to launch a hotel website, showcase a property, and take and manage bookings. Installation can be done either with the downloadable package through a web installer, or with a Docker image (webkul/qloapps_docker). The installer checks server compatibility and will not proceed if the server does not meet requirements. The README says QloApps Core is under OSL-3.0, Webkul-authored modules carry their own licenses, and other modules are under AFL-3.0. Contributions are accepted via pull requests. The README does not describe specific booking features in detail.
use_cases: run a booking engine for a hotel
how_to_run: Alternatively, download QloApps and follow the installation guide in the QloApps documentation (web installer)
stack: PHP extensions: PDO_MySQL, cURL, OpenSSL, SOAP, GD, SimpleXML, DOM, Zip, Phar
notable: Open-source hotel reservation system and booking engine under OSL-3.0
Installer checks server compatibility before proceeding
Local setup supported via WampServer, XAMPP, or EasyPHP
Modules may carry different licenses (OSL-3.0, AFL-3.0, or Webkul module licenses)
caveats: Requires a PHP and MySQL server stack with specific extensions and PHP settings (memory_limit 128M, upload_max_filesize 16M, max_execution_time 500)
Processing payments internally requires an SSL certificate; the README suggests PayPal as an alternative
The README does not document detailed features, and the documentation link is empty in the provided text
keywords: free alternative to hotel booking platforms
